lines.speaker: needles
lines.text: Everyone keeps looking at my sword like it'll bite.

lines.speaker: needles
lines.text: Only people I don't like. It found me in a gutter when I was nine.

lines.speaker: mc
lines.text: And it's talked to you ever since.

lines.speaker: needles
lines.text: It counts. Doors, guards, coins. Lately it counts blades. It's up to three.

lines.speaker: blade
lines.text: Three of ten. The child is better at sums than you.
